principles: Persistent VESSEL-03 module identifiers must not change when spatial bounds are assigned.
Every module must fit inside one non-overlapping integer-cell bounding box.
Adaptive cell size must keep the aggregate envelope at or below the configured cell cap.
Utility and access routes must terminate at existing modules or infrastructure anchors.
Main-engine exhaust, radiator view fields, and weapon sight lines must remain clear.
Condition, combat tracking, weapon performance, and local damage remain deferred.
